_comment: Every route is prerendered to its own static HTML file, so the previous catch-all rewrite to /index.html is gone: it would have served the homepage, with a 200, for every unknown URL. Vercel now serves the prerendered file for known paths and dist/404.html with a real 404 status for everything else. The redirects below mirror the client-side ones in src/Routers.tsx as 301s so search engines see a permanent redirect rather than a JavaScript hop. They are generated from the id and slug fields in src/jsonData; regenerate if those change.
